reviews.title: Ridiculous Questions
reviews.text: I haven’t used this app in a while, opened it, and was confronted with a half dozen BS questions about “mindfulness”.  Wtf!?  This is a MOON PHASES app, these questions never used to exist, how off putting!

reviews.title: I HATE the notifications
reviews.text: Other people have said this for years and yet I see that the weird push notifications still keep coming. I know I can turn these off, but I don’t understand why someone would even be writing them in the first place, much less deciding to hit “send.” Switching to Moonget, which also has a nice widget and minimal interface and doesn’t interrupt my day with “THE SAFE WORD IS YOGURT.”
